shell_commands: /usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"specs/.+#|spec:|@spec|validated by\" src --glob '*.test.ts' | head -65; cat jest.config.js; cat src/types/ai.ts | head -95; rg -n '\"ajv\"|node_modules/ajv' package-lock.json | head"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "cat scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs | head -145; rg -n 'specs/.*#[0-9]+|@spec|spec anchor' scripts src | head -50; rg -n '\"node_modules/ajv\"' -A 9 package-lock.json"
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "head -65 CHANGELOG.md; rg -n 'validated by:|#L[0-9]+' specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md; git diff --stat; git status --short"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write .lore/dod.md CHANGELOG.md package.json package-lock.json scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git diff --check && git diff --stat && nl -ba src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts | head -12 && nl -ba src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts | sed -n '90,98p' && git diff -- .lore/dod.md package.json scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md CHANGELOG.md package-lock.json package.json scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts && git commit -m "Compile static tool schemas at registration"'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main'
